informal_statement:
If \(\lambda>1\) and \(-1<z<1\), then \(1-z^2\), \(\lambda^2-z^2\),
\[
\sqrt{1-z^2},
\]
and
\[
\lambda\sqrt{\lambda^2-z^2}
\]
are strictly positive.
reason: Source `CMVElementary.lean:177-186`: All four strict positivity conclusions and the open argument interval are retained; these justify the derivative denominators.
